propositions: The concurrency overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS enum and wired into the overlay_union step to generate the include_concurrency flag for workflow dispatch.

A committed token list (36 lexical cues spanning threading, async tasks, multiprocessing, locks, channels, and DB/file locking) must be added to content_triggered_overlays to scan both added and removed diff lines for concurrency indicators.
The concurrency overlay must be dispatched in both round_a and round_b batches of the code-review.yaml gate, gated on the generated include_concurrency output flags.
Routing configuration must assign concurrency an advisory posture with 0.95 block_threshold and blocking_enabled=false, reflecting the over-fire tolerance and calibrated 14% fire rate.

The concurrency overlay catalog entry must be added to code-review-base.md as a recognition cue, and negative control tests must verify that excluded tokens (async/await, fork, Promise.all, etc.) do not trigger the overlay.
